summary: A 1970s-style string machine on four tracks, each with its own ensemble and phaser, mixed through send effects and a master bus, with OberVave's step sequencer.
features: 16 shared keyers with divider-style 16', 8', 4' saw and 8' square footages
Six formant registers from contrabass and cello to trumpet and horn
Three-line bucket-brigade ensemble and six-stage phaser per track
Delay, plate reverb and drive sends; master DJ filter and compressor
Four sequencer tracks of up to 256 steps; 8 patterns; 32 factory programs
USB and TRS MIDI in; four sounds at once roughly double the CPU load
